description: Multilingual + Voice Explanation feature: create VoiceExplainer component and add it to prediction result panels (PatientDashboard, GuestDashboard) and to MedicalVault pathology summaries. Depends on FEAT-001 (explain endpoint), can run after FEAT-002 (uses result panels). Independent of FEAT-003.
steps:
2. In frontend/src/pages/dashboard/PatientDashboard.jsx: (a) Import VoiceExplainer at the top: `import VoiceExplainer from '../../components/VoiceExplainer';`. (b) In the result display section, find where `result.clinical_reasoning` is rendered (it's displayed in the results panel). Immediately after the clinical_reasoning text block, add:
```jsx
{result.clinical_reasoning && (
  <VoiceExplainer text={result.clinical_reasoning} label='Listen' />
)}
```
This adds language selection + voice synthesis directly below the clinical reasoning paragraph.
3. In frontend/src/pages/dashboard/GuestDashboard.jsx: same change as step 2 — import VoiceExplainer and add it after the clinical_reasoning display block.
acceptance_criteria: VoiceExplainer component renders EN / தமிழ் / हिंदी buttons and a Listen button
Clicking தமிழ் or हिंदी calls POST /api/ai/explain/ and displays translated text
Clicking EN resets to original text without API call
Listen button invokes window.speechSynthesis with correct locale (en-IN, ta-IN, hi-IN)
When speechSynthesis is not supported, a 'TTS not supported' label renders instead of the button
VoiceExplainer appears below clinical_reasoning in PatientDashboard and GuestDashboard result panels
VoiceExplainer appears below summary in MedicalVault expanded pathology record
cd d:\MEDICAL_PROJECT\medfusion-ai\frontend && node_modules\.bin\vite build completes with 0 errors
